name: Baber Arjumand
headline: Software Engineer | Frontend Lead
availability: Remote worldwide · Delivered for teams in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and the Gulf

summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Software engineer and frontend lead with over 6 years building production web products.

highlights.label: Summary
items: Over 6 years building production web and mobile products; 4 years as Front End Lead and CTO.
Shipped cross-border payment, Web3 asset, and AI messaging platforms to release.
Owns system design, Go and REST APIs, CI/CD, automated testing, and iOS and Android release.

bullets: Operate a marketplace pairing students with private Quran teachers as sole product owner.
Architected a B2B cross-border payment platform from concept to alpha in 8 months.
Integrated Mastercard Digital Asset Solutions for institutional cross-border settlement.
Consolidated multi-branch corporate liquidity into one real-time dashboard.
Delivered campaign features reaching customers across 3 channels: WhatsApp, Messenger, Discord.
Engineered Go and PostgreSQL services on AWS for high-concurrency messaging workloads.
Migrated the customer inbox from Redux to Jotai, cutting state-management surface area.
Directed frontend architecture for a Web3 network verifying cross-chain assets and NFTs.
Migrated a legacy Angular codebase to React and Next.js, lifting performance and SEO.
Engineered multi-wallet authentication ahead of WalletConnect; led a distributed team.

items.role: Chief Technology Officer, then Full Stack Engineer
bullets: Set technical strategy and governed the delivery lifecycle across engineering teams.
Shipped Ionic apps with in-app subscriptions to the Apple and Google app stores.
Automated releases with CI/CD pipelines on AWS, Heroku, and Firebase.
